where_you_are: Sir Phidipaldi is at the Golden Egg Tavern with its owner Quinn. Wayman and Dr. Uriah are across the street at the Clumsy Fox Tavern. Dunk is at Farmer Gill's farm on the edge of town, where Gill has welcomed him to sleep in the barn.

immediate_intention.text: Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn are setting up a fake ale shipment to catch Bentley. Quinn is to bring bottles to fill with water, and Sir Phidipaldi will make a big show of delivering them.
